scripts.generate: cd ../../baml_language && cargo run -q -p baml_cli -- generate --project tools/type_quiz --output-dir ../typescript2/app-type-quiz/src/baml_sdk
scripts.prepare:deps: pnpm build:bridge && pnpm generate && pnpm build:wasm
scripts.typecheck: if [ -e src/baml_sdk/index.ts ] && [ -e wasm/baml_fmt_wasm.js ]; then tsc --noEmit; else echo 'app-type-quiz: typecheck skipped: generated inputs are absent (pnpm prepare:deps builds them; the app CI job checks them)'; fi
